Name: command
Description: Execute a command. This option can be specified multiple times. The commands are executed in the order they are specified.

Name: command-file
Description: Execute a command file. This option can be specified multiple times. The command files are executed in the order they are specified. Default when the option name is omitted.

Name: output-dependencies
Description: Output  command files dependencies instead of processing. Available styles are mpc (Meta Project Creator) or vs (Visual Studio).

Name: prompt
Description: Wait after processing or dependency output on a key press. Prompt for rerunning the command file(s).
